sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Alder software rollout: area policy (v1)
sources.body: For Alder software rollout, the east area policy is adopted. Its limit is 27 hosts. It takes effect on 2026-06-01. A proposal does not authorize work.

sources.body: For Alder software rollout, the east area policy is adopted with a limit of 20 hosts, effective 2026-06-10. This revision replaces the earlier area policy. Other operational prerequisites still apply.

sources.title: Alder software rollout: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Alder software rollout in the east area may proceed only when its area policy is adopted and failed smoke checks is at most 6. A withdrawn or proposed policy blocks work regardless of the measurement. The threshold uses the current measurement log, not the planning estimate.

sources.title: Alder software rollout: measurement log (v1)
sources.body: The current failed smoke checks for Alder software rollout in the east area is 8. This is the checked reading. The planning estimate was 13, and must not be used for the eligibility decision. No approval-ticket receipt is included in this log.

sources.title: Alder software rollout: handoff instructions (v1)
sources.body: For Alder software rollout in the east area, Noa 1 is the release steward. The next operator must receive the rollback checklist. Retain this handoff record for 21 days. A signed receipt proves delivery but does not replace the named handoff item. This handoff rule is independent of policy revisions and remains in force after a withdrawal.

The archival instruction remains historical; it is not a current area policy.
